Company: ABC Vietnam Business: Animal feed manufacturer and feed ingredients/raw materials trading company, operating three brands — ABC, Hoang Phat, and FeedToYou Location: Northern Vietnam

SAP Solution: SAP Cloud ERP
Implementation Partner: Citek (SAP Platinum Partner in Vietnam)
Implementation Timeline: 6 months from consulting to go-live

Challenges and Opportunities
ABC Vietnam views digital transformation not as a trend or short-term initiative, but as the essential foundation for long-term enterprise resilience and growth. With an ambitious Vision 2030 — targeting a position among the Top 10 domestic animal feed manufacturers in Northern Vietnam and Top 5 trading companies in feed ingredients and raw materials — the company recognised that its existing management infrastructure was not equipped to support the scale and complexity of that future.
The challenge was clear: ABC Vietnam needed a modern, integrated management platform capable of connecting operations end-to-end and sustaining accelerated growth. The decision to transform, as they describe it, required courage to change — not just a technology investment, but a fundamental shift in how the business operates.

Why SAP and Partner
ABC Vietnam selected SAP Cloud ERP as the platform to realise their long-term strategic vision, implementing it across procurement, inventory management, manufacturing, quality management, sales, finance and accounting, and e-Invoicing — all on a single unified platform.

Their implementation partner, Citek (SAP Platinum Partner, Vietnam), was central to the project's success. What stood out was Citek's approach to the engagement:

Demonstrated strong commitment, professionalism, and an execution mindset throughout the project
Treated challenges not as contractual obligations, but through a spirit of genuine partnership and mutual support
Worked collaboratively to find the best possible solutions for both organisations — a dynamic that left a lasting impression on ABC Vietnam's leadership
Business Outcomes
ABC Vietnam has identified three core pillars of value delivered:

Real-time data — acts as the "eyes of leadership," enabling accurate, timely decision-making across financial planning, inventory management, supply chain operations, and overall business execution

Transparency and end-to-end optimisation — connects every department, from finance and manufacturing through to procurement and R&D, reducing risk, minimising waste, and improving operational efficiency across the entire organisation

Superior customer service — with a strong operational foundation in place, ABC Vietnam can now deliver greater value and experiences that exceed customer expectations, honouring the trust customers place in them every day

SAP Cloud ERP has established the foundation for a new era of business management and operational excellence at ABC Vietnam — and positions the company with confidence to achieve its 2030 strategic objectives.

Company: Ahlada Engineers Limited (publicly listed) Business: India's leading manufacturer of steel doors and windows, also producing steel school furniture. The company started in 2005 manufacturing clean wood furniture before expanding into steel products for residential and commercial segments. Capacity: 30,000 doors and 50,000 windows per month Location: India Core Focus: Product quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction

SAP Solution: SAP Cloud ERP
Implementation Partner: Vestrics Solutions
Implementation Timeline: 90 man-days

Challenges and Opportunities
Prior to SAP, Ahlada Engineers was running a server-based ERP that presented significant operational constraints as the business scaled:

Limited data and reporting access — the legacy system could not provide the depth or breadth of insight the business needed
Inventory and raw materials visibility gaps — tracking stock and materials movement across multiple manufacturing units was difficult and largely manual
As a publicly listed manufacturer operating at high volumes across multiple product lines, the inability to make fast, data-backed decisions was becoming a competitive liability
These limitations prompted the search for a modern, cloud-based ERP that could keep pace with the company's scale and ambitions.

Why SAP and Partner
Ahlada chose SAP Cloud ERP for its ability to deliver end-to-end visibility across purchasing, finance, inventory control, and supply chain — all consolidated into a single integrated system. The platform enabled the shift to faster, data-driven decision-making across the business.

Their implementation partner, Vestrics Solutions, stood out for both their technical and business acumen:

Brought deep understanding of Ahlada's business practices alongside strong SAP technology expertise
Took a thorough, hands-on approach — visiting the plant multiple times to understand requirements firsthand
Listened patiently and ensured the solution was correctly mapped to real operational needs
Delivered the full implementation in just 90 man-days — a result Ahlada's leadership described as "quite impressive"
Business Outcomes
Within just 6 months of go-live, the results were already tangible:

80–85% improvement in operational efficiency — a significant and rapid uplift across the business
End-to-end visibility across purchase, finance, inventory, and supply chain on a single platform, eliminating the blind spots of the previous system
Faster, data-driven decisions — leadership now has the real-time data access needed to act quickly and confidently
Ahlada's experience reinforced a clear conviction: SAP Cloud ERP is not just an operational tool, but a strategic asset essential for maintaining a competitive edge and being future-ready.

Scale & Operational Complexity
CEEC had implemented SAP BusinessOne only the prior year, but the environment quickly proved insufficient for its compliance and growth needs. Procurement required an outsourced tool, purchase requests could proceed without approval, and tax reconciliation was difficult amid Brazil's evolving tax requirements. CEEC also had SLA concerns with the prior implementation provider and wanted a platform that could scale with aggressive expansion in Brazil. 

Deal Relevance
•	SAP BusinessOne → SAP Cloud ERP migration completed across 7 legal entities in 12 weeks. 
•	Strong finance-buyer story around procurement controls, tax complexity, compliance, and scalability. 
•	CEEC intends to more than double its Brazil business over the next 3–5 years. 
•	Initial internal timeline was 6 months; CEEC and Exed compressed delivery to 12 weeks. 
•	Protheus was considered, but CEEC moved directly to SAP Cloud ERP without formally quoting other ERPs. 
•	Strong myth-busting reference for buyers concerned that ERP modernization must take too long or be excessively painful. 

Buying Story
Finance Manager had wanted SAP Cloud ERP while implementing B1, but internal approval was not available at the time. After operational issues surfaced, she returned to the C-suite and argued that CEEC needed to move. SAP Cloud ERP stood out for rapid implementation and the ability to scale with expected growth. Exed was selected through a recommendation and differentiated itself by discussing finance and business outcomes rather than technicalities, then staying closely engaged on-site. 

Why SAP Cloud ERP: CEEC wanted a more robust, scalable cloud ERP that could support compliance, procurement, and future growth without relying on the external tools required around B1.

Transformation / Outcomes
CEEC brought 7 legal entities live in 12 weeks, versus an initial 6-month expectation. Procurement is the first area Nelha identified as materially different after go-live, but CEEC had not yet completed a full month or first close, so broader business-impact metrics remain unvalidated. 

Future Readiness
Planned: CEEC intends to expand Joule and automation only after teams understand the underlying processes. POC expects future value from automated financial statements/consolidation and inbound processes as adoption matures. 

Reference Fit
BEST FOR: Corporate/midmarket ERP modernization, SAP BusinessOne migration, multi-entity operations, finance leaders, procurement and compliance, Brazil tax complexity, rapid implementation, growth/scalability.

Following Victoria's fire services reform, the CFA faced the challenge of rebuilding its operational foundations for a new era. Leaders can now track expenditure across frontline services, volunteer support and operational functions and better demonstrate the value delivered through government investment.
The transformation has also streamlined finance and procurement by embedding approvals, delegations and procurement data within the ERP platform, strengthening governance, improving cybersecurity through single sign-on and providing greater insight into purchasing patterns to support more strategic procurement decisions.

As the lead agency for the majority of Victoria's major fires, CFA maintained timely supplier payments and uninterrupted business operations, ensuring local businesses supporting the emergency response continued to be paid promptly throughout the season.

Background and business drivers
H&T Battery Components (H&T Marsberg GmbH & Co. KG) is a global precision manufacturer of high-volume metal components for primary batteries, with production facilities in Europe, the United States, Singapore, and China. Migrating from a non-SAP environment (Microsoft Dynamics NAV 2016) to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, the company faced an end-of-life legacy system with no viable successor path, compounded by a rudimentary implementation that left significant business processes uncovered. Functional gaps were addressed through Excel-based workarounds that led to media discontinuities, data inconsistencies, process gaps, and limited mid-year transparency. Against this backdrop, H&T Battery Components identified a strategic opportunity to modernize its ERP landscape, standardize processes across all locations, and establish a future-proof global ERP platform to support international growth, cross-site collaboration, and AI-driven business innovation.

Solution and scope
Following a targeted evaluation phase and a proof of concept that confirmed the readiness of a public cloud solution for high-volume serial manufacturing, H&T Battery Components selected SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition as its central ERP platform. The solution covers end-to-end processes in Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Manufacturing, addressing the full requirements of a high-volume precision production environment. In the area of SAP Business AI, selected AI scope items, including Enterprise Search and Smart Summarisation, are already in active use. SAP Joule and SAP Central Invoice Management (CIM) with integrated Document AI are currently being rolled out as part of the company's ongoing AI journey.

Integration landscape and partners
NTT DATA Business Solutions AG (Bielefeld, Germany) served as the implementation partner, accompanying H&T Battery Components throughout the entire transformation, from evaluation and proof of concept through to go-live, with global delivery from Germany, Spain, and India. The implementation included the connection of an automated high-bay warehouse; minor schedule impacts in this specific workstream were attributable to the responsible third-party service provider and did not affect the core SAP project, which was delivered on time.

Business benefits and impact
Since go-live in September 2025, H&T Battery Components has achieved 100% transparency in inventory valuations, replacing isolated Excel-based solutions that had previously obscured financial visibility. The company now benefits from centralized, transparent, and auditable planning data, enhancing operational resilience. Processes that were difficult or impossible to map in the legacy system can now be executed in a flexible and standardized manner, increasing operational agility. The integrated SAP platform also enables the modeling of new procurement and business models, providing the foundation for future growth with efficient use of resources.

Background and business drivers: Kajima (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd. is a construction and engineering company headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, with approximately 300–350 employees. Backed by Kajima Corporation (Japan), the company delivers end-to-end project delivery across commercial, industrial, infrastructure, and mixed-use developments in Malaysia. As the business grew in complexity, its manual and fragmented processes could no longer keep pace. Project sites operated locally and reported periodically, while headquarters consolidated data retrospectively — creating latency, data discrepancies, and month-end friction. Headquarters lacked real-time visibility into site-level decisions affecting group liquidity, and governance gaps exposed financial risks only after the fact.

Solution and scope: Kajima (Malaysia) selected GROW with SAP — SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition — as its core ERP solution. The implementation replaced fragmented manual workflows with standardized, integrated processes built on SAP best practices. The deployment covered financial management, project cost control, procurement, and operational reporting. The full cycle from planning to go-live was completed in 6–7 months, with a go-live date of February 20, 2026.

Integration landscape and partners: TDI APJ Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. (Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia) supported Kajima across the full project lifecycle, including planning, implementation, and post-go-live Application Managed Services (AMS). No additional third-party integration partners or integrated products are specified in the available material.

Business benefits and impact: The transformation delivered measurable improvements in operational efficiency, financial control, and decision-making. Earned Value Management (EVM) cycle time was reduced from 30 days to 3 days, enabling earlier risk intervention. Real-time data access replaced periodic manual reporting across project sites and headquarters, establishing a single source of truth and eliminating the "your numbers vs. our numbers" disconnect. Financial governance and compliance were strengthened through auditable, consistent project profitability tracking. Employee morale improved as teams shifted away from repetitive manual tasks toward higher-value analysis and forecasting.

Scale & operational complexity
International growth required consistent accounting with local currencies and statutory requirements. Separate project and finance processes left staff collecting time sheets and assembling reports manually, limiting capacity for project control and analysis.

Deal relevance
	• Professional services requiring connected time entry, projects and billing.
	• Cross-border growth requiring local transactions and consistent accounting.
	• CFO and delivery teams seeking more analysis and better resource use.
	• ERP evaluations involving a customer with implementation expertise across platforms.

Buying story
As a technology implementation partner buying for itself, Korcomptenz worried about finance/project setup and employee adoption. Professional services templates, country localization and time-sheet functionality drove selection; firsthand customer experience also mattered.

Why SAP Cloud ERP: Industry fit and standardized accounting supported the intended global operating model and future entity growth.

Transformation / outcomes
	• Approximately 48 hours/month saved collecting time sheets for invoicing, freeing capacity for cost and profitability analysis.
	• An underutilized consultant assigned to new work instead of recruiting externally, avoiding one hire.
	• Uniform accounting across entities, supporting local-currency transactions on a common accounting basis.
	• Reported 18–24% efficiency improvement across project activities; measurement definition unconfirmed.

Future readiness
Live today: Joule directs users to apps/process paths; no measured AI benefit. In implementation: Group consolidation, expected to reduce effort from 24 to 4–5 hours/cycle. Planned: Remaining SAP reports, expected to free another 88 hours/month; evaluation of suitable Joule use cases.

Background and business drivers SAT Anlagentechnik GmbH specializes in the development, manufacturing and commissioning of automated filling, testing and handling systems for automotive final assembly. The company builds turnkey industrial systems used in the production facilities of major automotive manufacturers worldwide. SAT faced a critical challenge typical of mid-sized companies: grown IT structures, custom developments and repurposed processes had become a burden. Lack of transparency and high complexity prevented efficient processes, particularly affecting the project business. At the same time, requirements for scalability, reporting and international collaboration were increasing. The status quo was clear: things could not continue this way.

Solution and scope The decision was deliberate: a complete ERP restart based on the Back-to-Standard principle. Together with HPC Aktiengesellschaft as implementation partner, SAT selected SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition within GROW with SAP to build a future-proof, scalable system landscape. The implementation covered core modules MM, SD, PP, EWM and FI/CO, with integration of SAP Sales Cloud, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Concur, AEB and PLMSI. Go-live was delivered within the planned timeframe in January 2026.

Integration landscape and partners HPC Aktiengesellschaft served as implementation partner, applying the SAP Activate methodology. HPC provided holistic consulting, customizing and implementation, data migrations, replacement of existing custom developments, and employee training and enablement. Joule was deployed as a digital AI assistant and AI-generated suggestion values were activated in SAP Concur.

Business benefits and impact Through a group-wide standardized SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud template, processes were harmonized and the foundation for significantly better scalability within the corporate group was created. The company now benefits from a unified data basis, higher transparency and standardized evaluation options across all entities. Individual custom solutions were reduced and process maintainability improved. Together with HPC, SAT won the SAP Quality Award in the category "Rapid Time to Value."

Saudi Aramco Total Refining & Petrochemical Company (SATORP), a joint venture between Saudi Aramco and TotalEnergies, opted for SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Public Edition in a competitive evaluation process. SAP’s solutions were assessed against leading competitors in the industry, including Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance, and Infor CloudSuite. 

The implementation of SAP S/4HANA Cloud replaced legacy systems predominantly characterized by fragmented and siloed processes, lower automation capabilities, and a lack of real-time analytics. These previous systems were increasingly challenging to maintain, upgrade, and align with the evolving demands of the energy and petrochemical sector.

SATORP faced several business challenges, including the need for an integrated enterprise system to streamline operations, improve financial visibility across global operations, and enhance predictive planning. Fragmented data sources created inefficiencies in both supply chain and financial processes, leading the company to seek a more robust, scalable, and intelligently automated cloud solution. Additionally, compliance with industry-specific regulatory requirements and the demand for accelerating digital transformation was a critical driver in the decision-making process.

SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Public Edition, was selected due to its real-time data integration, embedded, and industry-specialized capabilities tailored to the oil and gas sector. The comprehensive cloud-based solution offered scalability, flexibility, and seamless integration with other SAP products, which helped future-proof the organization against technological obsolescence. Moreover, SAP’s established reputation in the energy and chemicals industry and its ability to deliver value-driven outcomes were key factors influencing the decision.

By choosing SAP, SATORP aims to significantly simplify its operations, enhance decision-making through real-time insights, and address critical industry requirements while accelerating its journey toward digital transformation. The solution positions SATORP to achieve operational excellence and improved sustainability performance.

Sebapharma selected GROW with SAP based on SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition Premium as the strategic foundation for its ERP transformation. The solution provides a scalable and standardized cloud platform that supports global process harmonization, accelerates innovation, and reduces long-term IT complexity. A Digital Discovery Assessment (DDA) and Fit-to-Standard workshops demonstrated that SAP best-practice processes could cover the majority of requirements while simplifying the overall landscape. The scope also includes SAP Integrated Product Development and SAP Integration Suite. SAP Cloud ALM was used to manage the implementation, with a planned go-live in November 2026.

Integration landscape and partners
The implementation is led by Innovabee GmbH (Waiblingen, Germany), whose industry expertise and SAP Public Cloud experience provided confidence in the transformation approach. SAP Integration Suite addresses integration requirements across the landscape, and the project consolidates data from multiple legacy ERP systems into the unified SAP cloud platform.

Business benefits and impact
With go-live still pending, quantifiable KPIs are not yet available. Expected outcomes include improved production planning and machine utilization, more reliable delivery visibility, standardized processes, and reduced master data inconsistencies. As Dr. Daniel Rothoeft, Deputy Chairman of the Executive Board, stated: "We will benefit from release updates and numerous innovative features twice a year, almost automatically and effortlessly. We not only recognize the many advantages but also know that we have a tremendous need for these capabilities."

2. **Operational Inefficiencies:** Disparate systems and manual processes created inefficiencies and hampered real-time data access, leading to poor decision-making.  
3. **Regulatory Compliance Risks:** The legacy systems struggled to ensure reliable and transparent compliance with evolving financial and regulatory standards.  
4. **Customer Experience:** The organization sought a solution to improve operational agility and enable enhanced customer service delivery.

**Selection of SAP Solutions:**  
After a thorough evaluation, SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Public Edition, was selected due to its robust functionalities, cloud agility, and industry-leading innovation. The platform offered:  
- **Real-Time Analytics:** Advanced AI and predictive insights for better decision-making.  
- **Seamless Scalability:** A cloud-based system capable of supporting Tide’s growth effectively.  
- **Integrated Processes:** End-to-end automation, streamlining financial, operational, and compliance tasks.  
- **Global and Regulatory Expertise:** Built-in support for multi-country operations and compliance standards.

Business Context
YLA operates in a complex, multi-system logistics environment spanning trucking, freight forwarding, warehousing, and global operations.
Their previous ERP (D365 F&O) became over-customized, limiting scalability and reducing system agility.
Two primary drivers for change:
	1. Excessive Customization – Technical debt was compounding.
	2. Functionality & Automation Gap – Modern ERP capabilities in automation, reconciliation, and operational efficiency surpassed what D365 provided.

Decision Rationale
Why Move Off D365?
	• Over-customization created rigidity.
	• Automation and advanced ERP capabilities were limited.
	• Needed a platform built for long-term scalability.
Why SAP Cloud ERP?
	• Modern architecture with strong automation potential.
	• Phased commercial model — no need to front-load licenses.
	• Strong global presence vs. competitors.
	• Competitive pricing when structured correctly.
	• Public Cloud demo shifted perception from “legacy SAP complexity” to modern usability.
Why Not Workday?
	• Very close competition.
	• Ultimately lost due to SAP’s stronger global footprint.
Perception Shift
Initial hesitation wasn’t about SAP being “too big.”
It was about SAP being “too complicated.”
Public Cloud changed that narrative.

YLA is a high-complexity logistics operator choosing Public Cloud over D365 redo and Workday.
This story is valuable because:
	• It’s a competitive displacement (D365 → SAP).
	• It counters the “SAP too complex” narrative.
	• It reframes the “too expensive” objection.
	• It reinforces global scale credibility.
	• It highlights automation as a forward-looking value driver.

“We over-customized D365. Modern ERP brings more robust functionality and far more automation potential.”

“Until I saw the Public Cloud demo, I assumed SAP would be overly complicated. What I saw was a modern, advanced system that actually fits where we’re headed.”

“It’s labeled expensive, but there are options out there that cost more. If you structure it right, you buy what you need now and scale when you’re ready.”
